mechanism: Both drugs can impair renal function; ramipril reduces glomerular filtration rate while piperacillin-tazobactam is renally cleared, increasing antibiotic accumulation and potential nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) baseline and during therapy; adjust piperacillin-tazobactam dosing if renal impairment develops; assess for signs of acute kidney injury.
